status: Prepared source review; no hosted authorization

privileged_source_delta.capability: Lazy existing server-only Supabase client, only after caller-RLS prechecks, used only for service admission begin/finish. No service client private-data reads/writes and no credential/settings change.

caller_boundary: Authenticated middleware and server actor retained. Required loaded-viewer UUID must match current actor before any read/admission.
Caller-RLS can_edit_student, non-partner, can_view_document and exact active extraction/document source checks happen before loading the service capability.

Atomic student/transition/evidence/audit/completion writes stay on the caller client. SQL retains invoker permissions and all original body statements, adding only the transaction-held control-row lock.

refusal_boundary.confirmed: Only received null-data errors with exact string SQLSTATE42501 or55000 from this fixed database-only atomic RPC are settled refusals. Finish operation once as completed, then report failure, never saved success.
refusal_boundary.uncertain: Lost response, gateway/missing function, mixed data/error, malformed/foreign success or malformed code retain uncertainty; no fallback/retry. Failed finish never returns success or issues a second finish.
refusal_boundary.assumption: Deployment must verify the reviewed routine/schema/trigger context. This classification is not reusable for arbitrary provider or nontransactional endpoints.

sql_gate.requires: Reviewed canonical atomic prosrc MD5, invoker/search path, admission control RLS, paused control and no unresolved tracked operations before installation.
sql_gate.helper: Authenticated-only definer reads/locks only control state; no new student access, table privilege or service execution.
sql_gate.scope: One database-only atomic Apply transaction, including direct RPC. Does not fence other direct student writers, sequential legacy handlers, storage/provider work or all review mutations.

client_boundary: Review is bound to loaded account/document generation, including leave-and-return. Prior account data is hidden immediately while the next review loads.
Late load, extract, section/meta save or Apply outcomes cannot update a departed screen, toast or navigate. Old request continuations are not canceled or undone.
Old cached clients without expected_viewer_id fail before admission with a plain reload message; coherent client refresh remains a release requirement.
remaining: Register/rescan, browser upload continuation and separate worker still require admission integration.
Retained-hold admission limits and audited manual reconciliation remain open; no automatic expiry/delete/release.

Admission/control and Apply gate remain two noncanonical unapplied proposals, outside the prepared fifteen-migration batch. Final canonical/ledger packaging and hosted data/preflight are required before release.
No provider/legacy complete-drain, retention or whole-writer-graph proof; current status flags remain false.
